subject: prd/argus-unattended-drive
statement: When a proposal is evaluated, the lane classifier shall route it into exactly one of two lanes — AUTO or HUMAN — with HUMAN as the lane for every proposal not positively classified AUTO-eligible.
rationale: two lanes, fail-toward-human default (GATE-4 shape; vision §6 L3)
fit_criterion: on the classification corpus, every proposal receives exactly one recorded lane; every unclassifiable input routes HUMAN
